note: TDD-033 (L-22): L-22 moved the nightly shuffle from cargo nextest (which has no --shuffle flag) to pinned-nightly libtest. The old m4 mutated the deleted nextest install step; the re-aimed class drops the shuffle flag from run-shuffle.sh's live command line — the nightly run would silently degrade to a plain ordered run. The gate's live-line pin (^cargo +nightly test .* -Z unstable-options --shuffle) catches it.
